howItWorks.title: How end to end automation works
howItWorks.subtitle: Three simple steps. Everything else is handled by LearnPack.

step1.title: Input your content or idea
step1.description: Upload documents or answer four guided questions about topic, audience and goals.

step2.title: AI builds the course
step2.description: LearnPack generates lessons, quizzes and activities automatically.

step3.title: AI maintains it over time
step3.description: Rigobot helps refine content, adjust examples and add new material without rebuilding.

support.control: Rigobot answers questions and guides learners contextually.

formats.question: What formats can I upload?
formats.answer: You can start from PDFs, videos, Word files, slide decks or simply describe your idea.

lms.question: Does it work with our LMS?
lms.answer: Yes. You can export SCORM or embed the course directly with an iframe.

update.question: How often can I update a course?
update.answer: As often as you want. Rigobot helps refine or rewrite content instantly.
